name: Candlemas

attributes.attribute: Celtic festival on the same day

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Candlemas is a Christian feast. Christians observe the day on February 2. The feast shares that date with the Celtic festival of Imbolc. Monaghan’s entry sends readers to Imbolc for the full account.

okr.objective: Candlemas is a Christian feast aligned with Imbolc.
key_results: The source directs a reader to Imbolc.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
